questions.question: Kathy is working through a batch of phones that need repairs. The number remaining can be estimated with the equation P = 108 − 23d, where P is the number of phones left and d is the number of days she has worked that week. What is the meaning of the value 108 in this equation?

choices.A: There are 108 phones to fix at the start of the week.
choices.B: The work is done at a rate of 23 phones per day.
choices.C: The job is completed after 108 days.
choices.D: The work is done at a rate of 108 phones per day.

questions.explanation: When d = 0 (the start), P = 108, so 108 is the initial amount. The rate is 23 phones per day.
